decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of its precision wafer portfolio, the glass-silicon wafer with vertical through contacts fits the firm's R&D-led strategy and addresses growing demand for more complex wafer-level integration.

The carrier wafer for handling smaller diameter wafers directly supports the firm's established thin-wafer and handling business, and with the product only launched in 2018 there is no strong reason to withdraw it in a growing market.
